# spyro ssh

Open an interactive shell on a profile's server.

## Before you run it

Interactive shell starting in `remote_path` (when set); `--home` starts in HOME. Needs a real terminal.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro ssh`

```text
Usage: spyro ssh [OPTIONS]

  Open an interactive shell on a profile's server.

  Starts in the profile's remote_path (when spyro.toml sets one); use --home to start in your home
  directory instead. Uses keychain-stored credentials and handles auth automatically.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Profile name (auto-detects if only one exists)
  --home, --root      Start in your home directory (where ssh normally lands) instead of the
                      profile's remote_path
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```
